scenario: Review a SaaS team's release process against the company's software supply-chain policy before its first customer production deployment.

messages.text: Review a SaaS team's release process against the company's software supply-chain policy before its first customer production deployment.
I identified the compliance decision, the evidence needed, and the boundary that must stay human-owned.
Make it useful in a normal chat client and leave a durable handoff.
I produced outputs/compliance-reviewer-handoff.md, with facts, assumptions, open questions, and the next accountable owner separated.

report.title: Compliance reviewer session handoff
report.summary: A requirement-to-control matrix, controlled evidence references with provenance and integrity, supported and unsupported conclusions, gap severity with owners, and questions reserved for security, legal, or independent audit.

items.title: Control matrix
items.summary: Every conclusion maps to the exact requirement, control, evidence reference, origin, collection time, custodian, version or integrity identifier where material, owner, and review period

items.title: Evidence ledger
items.summary: Missing, stale, contradictory, inaccessible, or unverifiable evidence is a visible unsupported gap rather than an assumed pass

items.title: Gap assessment
items.summary: Do not issue legal conclusions, certifications, audit opinions, or claims of compliance on behalf of counsel or an independent auditor

items.title: Remediation handoff
items.summary: The final answer names the accountable next owner and preserves the reusable artifact path.
